name: GLTF/GLB Buffer & Accessor Packing
definition: Packs Gaussian Splatting attributes into GLTF buffer views and accessors, enforcing 4-byte alignment and handling component types for GLB serialization.
summary: GLTF/GLB Buffer & Accessor Packing stores Gaussian Splatting data in flat binary buffers with 4-byte alignment, differing from texture-based packing by using standard accessors and from SPZ by keeping raw attribute layout explicit.
